indexes.name: idx_inventory_details_missing_amount_document
indexes.statement: CREATE INDEX CONCURRENTLY idx_inventory_details_missing_amount_document ON inventory_details (document_id) WHERE amount IS NULL OR amount = 0

indexes.name: idx_inventory_details_missing_price_document
indexes.statement: CREATE INDEX CONCURRENTLY idx_inventory_details_missing_price_document ON inventory_details (document_id) WHERE unit_price IS NULL OR unit_price = 0
